subject: Ardent Health — security kickoff & questionnaire path
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@ardenthealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — security path & next steps

Hi Claire — great to meet today, and thanks for walking through the integration surface. Quick recap and a proposed path to get your security team comfortable: 

Recap (from our call)
- You confirmed the integration will process PHI for scheduling and clinical reminders (names, dates, limited clinical codes).
- Ardent needs a signed BAA and SOC 2 Type II evidence before production onboarding.
- Preferred approach: start with SIG prefill + SOC2 summary; legal will review BAA in parallel.

Open clarifying questions for your team (so we scope evidence correctly)
1) Data residency: will any Ardent tenant require EU data residency, or is US-only sufficient for this initial integration?
2) Encryption key management: do you require customer-managed keys (BYOK) or is provider-managed KMS acceptable for now?
3) Scoped environments: do you need prod access controls + separate staging environment with the same compliance posture?
4) Evidence owners: please confirm the names / roles for the following items: SOC2 reviewer, infra contact, app security owner, and legal point-of-contact.

Proposed next steps
- We can push a SIG prefilling spreadsheet to you today (will attach) and request the minimal evidences (SOC2 summary, dataflow diagram, encryption config).
- Redwood will provide a SOC2 summary (attached) and a starting dataflow diagram for you to annotate.
- Suggest a 30-minute kickoff with your security + legal next Tuesday to align on the evidence owners and timeline.

Attachments included: redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf, sig-prefill-checklist.xlsx, a starter dataflow diagram.

If SIG is not preferred, we can instead share our CAIQ export — let me know which the security team prefers.

If your legal wants to loop in before the kickoff, happy to include them on the thread.

Thanks — I’ll hold Tuesday 11/25 11:00–11:30 PT if that works.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187
https://redwood.ai

From: Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@ardenthealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@ardenthealth.com>, Legal Ops <legal@ardenthealth.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — security path & next steps

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick answers and clarifications from our side: 

Answers to your questions
- Data residency: US-only for our initial rollout; we may need EU later but not in scope for the first phase.
- Encryption: provider-managed KMS is OK for now, but we need documentation showing AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit.
- Environments: we require a logically separated staging environment with parity controls (access logs, RBAC, and encryption).

Evidence / POIs
- SOC2 reviewer: Devon Park (devon.park@ardenthealth.com) — owns internal compliance review.
- Infra/security contact: Claire Thompson (me) for high-level, but I’ll loop in our infra lead in the kickoff.
- Legal POC: Legal Ops (legal@ardenthealth.com) — they’ll need the BAA and any data processing terms.

SIG vs CAIQ
- Preference: SIG prefill is fine — our security team prefers that format. If you can prefill obvious answers and call out areas that need vendor evidence, that’ll speed things up.

Timeline
- We can target returning a prefilling + evidence bundle within 10 business days after the kickoff. Legal will review the BAA in parallel but may take longer (we’ll flag if they need doc changes).

Kickoff
- Tuesday 11/25 at 11:00 PT works for me. Please include Karthik from your side for technical details and Marissa for escalation/contracting context.

Thanks — I’ll ask Legal to confirm if they want to attend the kickoff; otherwise they’ll handle BAA asynchronously.

Claire Thompson
Director, Information Security
Ardent Health
claire.thompson@ardenthealth.com | +1 (206) 555-0123

Claire — perfect, thanks for the quick clarifications. Confirming next items and owners so nothing falls through the cracks: 

Action items (owners)
- Redwood: prefill SIG spreadsheet and mark answers we can provide automatically (Ben).
- Redwood: attach full SOC2 Type II summary (controls list + auditor/contact) — Ben (attached stub).
- Redwood: update the dataflow diagram to show staging separation and encryption layers — Karthik to produce an updated drawio.
- Ardent: SOC2 review + prefilling — Devon (devon.park@ardenthealth.com).
- Ardent: Legal review + BAA — Legal Ops (legal@ardenthealth.com).

Kickoff and timeline
- Kickoff call: Tue 11/25 11:00–11:30 PT — meeting invite to follow.
- Target for prefilling + evidence return: ~10 business days after kickoff (goal: 2025-12-09). If legal requires BAA changes, provisioning to staging may be delayed until BAA is executed.

Quick clarifications we’ll surface in the SIG prefill
- We’ll call out that PHI is in-scope and annotate which API fields contain PHI.
- For encryption, we’ll include the KMS model (provider-managed) and link to our key-rotation policy section in the SOC2 summary.
- For hosting, we’ll note US-only for the initial rollout and reference our region controls.

Attachments (stubs)
- redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf
- sig-prefill-checklist.xlsx (prefill in progress)
- ardent-redwood-dataflow-v1.drawio (will update to show staging)

If legal wants a draft BAA before the kickoff, Marissa — can you please provision the standard BAA draft and share with Ardent Legal?

Thanks all — I’ll send the calendar invite and drop the prefilling spreadsheet link into the invite notes. 

Best,
